senses.gloss:
कूज्^1 कूजति कूज˚ते make inarticulate sounds. cry, sing
(of a bird), coo, caw, hum, moan, groan, etc. —अनु follow in crying
etc. अभि, आ, उद्, वि, सम्
= S.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
कूज m. कूजन & कू˚जित n. crying, singing, etc.
